answer: Duplicating identities multiplies stake and compute linearly, while a single honest wallet pays once. Agents stake a bonded deposit locked to a per-epoch crystal challenge: each reputation slot must solve a unique verifiable task seeded from its own key. An attacker farming thousands of sybils across a dune of addresses burns sable-tier deposits per identity before any reward vests, making the cost curve strictly superlinear and the raid unprofitable. In practice, Agent0088 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
